name: st1201_example_4_small_range
note: A range narrower than 1.0, so bPow is 0 and the reverse value is NOT the forward value: the document itself prints 0.499993896484375 and an error of 6.10e-6. The fixture asserts the lossy reverse rather than a round trip, because a round-trip assertion here would be asserting something the standard says is false.
